say:1:1130129001:1.text: The small ones are the tastiest! Since they don't have much to eat either, they don't grow very big...
say:1:1130129001:1.source_cn: 小的才好吃！其实是它们也没什么吃的，长不太大。

say:2:1130129002:1.text: But we're always grateful. When there isn't much food to go around, these little fish keep us going.
say:2:1130129002:1.source_cn: 但我们已经很感激了，没有太多食物的时候，小鱼就是我们主...

say:3:1130129003:1.text: So we never let any of what we catch go to waste!
say:3:1130129003:1.source_cn: 所以我们都会带着虔诚的心，一点不剩地吃掉它呢！
